content.title: Oscars 2026 Winners List: 'One Battle After Another' wins Best Picture; Michael B. Jordan scripts History
content.text: Key PointsOscars 2025 features a close contest between Sinners and One Battle After Another.Michael B. Jordan and Jessie Buckley are current favorites in lead acting categories.Conan O’Brien hosts; PARADE will update live results throughout the ceremony. Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another dominated the 98th Academy Awards and emerged as the biggest winner of the night by taking home six Oscars, including Best Picture. Meanwhile, Michael B. Jordan became the sixth Black actor to win the Best Actor (Male) accolade for his performances in Ryan Coogler’s Sinners.Read More As always, the evening began with the famous red carpet, where actors, filmmakers, and other stars show up in their most eye-catching outfits. However, the focus was not on the looks but on the people walking the red carpet, and everyone was waiting to see which of their favorite films and performances would receive the golden statuette. ‘One Battle After Another’ Triumphs; Ryan Coogler Achieves Monumental Feat Much of this year’s conversation has centered on two standout titles: Sinners and One Battle After Another. Directed by Ryan Coogler, Sinners surprised many by collecting 16 nominations, the highest number ever for a single film in the history of the Academy Awards. Close behind is One Battle After Another, the latest film from Paul Thomas Anderson, which secured 13 nominations. Without any guesses, both these films turned out to be a force to be reckoned with and won multiple trophies. Apart from winning Best Picture, Anderson also won the Best Director trophy for the aforementioned black comedy. On the other hand, Coogler created history by becoming the SECOND BLACK FILMMAKER/WRITER to win the Original Screenplay award for Sinners. Jordan Peele was the first Black Screenwriter to win the accolade for his movie Get Out. Cinematographer Autumn Durald Arkapaw won the Best Cinematography award at the star-studded night for Sinners and went on to become the FIRST WOMAN EVER to win in the category mentioned above. Warner Bros. Pictures The Best Actor race shaped up to be one of the most unpredictable of the awards season. However, it was Michael B. Jordan who emerged victorious in the category and thanked all the Black Actors who took the stage before him. In the female category, Jessie Buckley became the FIRST IRISH ACTRESS to win the Best Actress trophy for her performance in Chloe Zhao’s Hamnet. Buckley went on to thank all the women present at the ceremony for their dedication to work. Amy Madigan stunned everyone with her victory in the Supporting Actress category. At the same time, Sean Penn, who was not present at the ceremony, took home the Supporting Actor trophy for his performance in One Battle After Another. Warner Bros.
